usage.callShape: GET https://domain.hugen.tokyo/domain/tech?domain=example.com (required query param `domain`; x402 payment ~$0.01 USDC on Base)
quirks: Input is a query-string parameter, not a JSON body: append ?domain=<host> to the URL.
Pass a bare hostname (e.g. example.com), not a full URL with scheme/path.
usage.guide: Call GET https://domain.hugen.tokyo/domain/tech with a required `domain` query parameter set to a bare hostname (e.g. ?domain=example.com). It is an x402 endpoint costing ~$0.01 USDC on Base (or Solana); pay it and read the JSON response synchronously. The detected stack is in body.technologies[], each entry having a name and categories[] (e.g. {"name":"Cloudflare","categories":["CDN"]}); body.technology_count gives the count.
